listing.name: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom — Switch edition (totk-recomp)
listing.summary: Experimental Documented AArch64 main and parts of SDK translated ahead of time to C++ for Linux x86-64, native Switch services/NVN-on-Vulkan runtime. Not a zeldaret matching-decomp playable route by association. Upstream maturity: One outdoor walk on author SteamDeck measured62–64fps, not full-game stability/completion. Shaders first-start warmup; faster codegen planned absent. PC clangO2 build17min wall/2.1hCPU, Deck estimate1–1.5h unmeasured. Acquisition: No releases/assets. Source build_from_xci.sh imports own dump, generates C++, compiles and packs local dist. Launcher setup/version/extraction UI exists but game-build button is NOT wired; CLI required. Capstone exactly5.0.9;16GBRAM and45GB peak disk documented. Outputs derived from game must remain private. Platforms: Linux x86-64 AVX2 (Haswell/Zen2 or newer); Steam Deck upstream tested. Windows/macOS not established. Build on Deck unmeasured; distrobox Ubuntu24.04 or Linux PC source route. Original data: Own1.0.0 cartridge XCI title0100F2C0115B6000, main buildID082CE09B06E33A12, ownprod.keys with master key revision0x0E. Other versions unsupported. Separate firmware not specified in root. Exact regional digest Unknown. Portcove setup/gameplay untested; no operational integration offered.
